name: local-llm
description: Offload small, low-stakes text jobs (summaries, classification, extraction, drafts) from Claude Code to a model running locally in LM Studio, over loopback only

allowed_dirs.title: Allowed folders
allowed_dirs.description: Folders the local model may read files from. Nothing outside them is readable. A leading $HOME or ~ is expanded; a folder name must not contain a comma.

endpoint_url.title: LM Studio endpoint
endpoint_url.description: Base URL of the LM Studio server. Keep it on loopback.

model.title: Model id
model.description: Model id to use. Leave empty to use whichever model LM Studio has loaded.
